zh_cn: 无需供电的独立种植设备
放入种子与合适的耕地
供水加速，缺水仍可工作
en_us: Standalone planting without power
Insert seeds and suitable soil
Water speeds up growth; works without water

zh_cn: 将生物样本培养为成熟培养物
放入已采样棉签、营养剂和空胶囊
需要供水；完成后消耗一份样本
en_us: Grows biological samples into mature cultures
Insert a sampled swab, nutrient and empty capsule
Requires water; consumes one sample per culture

zh_cn: 管理农业阵列的生产与库存目标
需要完整的 3×3×4 农业阵列
达到库存目标暂停，消耗后自动补货
en_us: Manages array production and stock targets
Requires a complete 3x3x4 agricultural array
Pauses at the stock target and replenishes after use

zh_cn: 为农业阵列提供种子
16 个槽位，每格最多 64 颗
手动取出占用种子会暂停对应作物
en_us: Supplies seeds to the agricultural array
16 slots, up to 64 seeds per slot
Manually taking reserved seeds pauses that crop

zh_cn: 集中管理本阵列使用的种子
自动收容新生种子，占用部分不供 AE 提取
点击“拉取种子”导入网络已有种子
en_us: Central seed storage for this array
Collects new seeds; AE cannot extract reserved seeds
Use Pull Seeds to import existing network seeds

zh_cn: 保存阵列产生的全部收获物
AE 仅可提取，不能存入
拆卸后保留库存与优先级
en_us: Stores all harvests produced by the array
AE can extract, but cannot insert
Retains its contents and priority when dismantled

zh_cn: 缓存并输出阵列产生的收获物
16 个槽位，可向正面容器自动输出
联网时也可由 AE 提取
en_us: Buffers and outputs array harvests
16 slots; can push to the container in front
AE can also extract while the array is online

zh_cn: 缩短阵列的生产周期
每座阵列最多安装 %s 个
提高速度，也会增加运行耗电
en_us: Shortens the array's production cycle
At most %s per array
Higher speed also increases running power

zh_cn: 提高同种作物的并行上限
每座阵列最多安装 %s 个
需要实际种子逐渐填满并行
en_us: Raises the parallel limit for each crop
At most %s per array
Fill parallel capacity with actual seeds

zh_cn: 将多余的新生种子转为对应收获物
优先补足并行，不消耗已有种子
不转换同时作为主产物的种植材料
en_us: Converts surplus new seeds into crop output
Fills parallel first; never consumes stored seeds
Does not convert planting items that are also the main crop

zh_cn: 为成型的农业阵列接入 ME 网络
每座阵列需要且只能安装一个
en_us: Connects a formed array to the ME network
Exactly one is required per array

zh_cn: ME 农业阵列的基础外壳
en_us: Basic casing for the ME agricultural array

zh_cn: 放置在农业阵列内部中轴的培养舱
en_us: Cultivation chamber for the array's inner column

zh_cn: 将生物萃取物凝聚为生物种子
附近投入萃取物与凝聚生物精华
随后右键放入空白生物种子，无需基座
en_us: Creates biological seeds from biological extract
Drop extract and condensed essence nearby
Then use a blank biological seed; no pedestals needed

zh_cn: 通过 ME 网络自动完成神秘农业注魔
替换原注魔祭坛中心，保留八个基座
支持 AE 加工样板与四张独立加速卡
en_us: Automates Mystical Agriculture infusion through ME
Replaces the altar center; keep all eight pedestals
Supports processing patterns and four separate acceleration cards

zh_cn: 右键生物采集样本
采样不伤害生物
采样后放入细胞培养器使用
en_us: Use on a mob to collect a sample
Sampling does not hurt the mob
Place the sampled swab in a Cell Cultivator

zh_cn: 用于封装生物培养物的空胶囊
en_us: An empty capsule used for biological cultures

zh_cn: 为细胞培养提供营养
en_us: Provides nutrients for cell cultivation

zh_cn: 投掷后获得对应的生物萃取物
右键投掷，或使用发射器
破碎后使附近玩家获得滋养效果
en_us: Throw to obtain the matching biological extract
Use to throw, or launch with a dispenser
Breaking it nourishes nearby players

zh_cn: 用于制作对应生物的种子
en_us: Used to create seeds for the matching mob

zh_cn: 在生物祭坛中凝聚为生物种子
先投入萃取物与凝聚精华，再右键放入
en_us: Becomes a biological seed at the Biological Altar
Drop extract and condensed essence, then use on the altar

zh_cn: 制作生物种子所需的通用材料
en_us: A shared ingredient for creating biological seeds

zh_cn: 种植后产出对应的生物精华
可种在耕地上，也可使用种植机
en_us: Grows into the matching biological essence
Plant on farmland or grow in a planter

zh_cn: 用于兑换对应生物的掉落物
en_us: Crafts into drops from the matching mob
